Grind 12 confirmed. Flow ramp smooth, ~1.2 g/s avg, settled near 2 g/s late. Stopped ~1.3g short of 36g target.

Grind 12 confirmed. First drip ~3s, ~1.5s slower than #18, near-identical curve. Back-to-back consistency: 0.1g and 1.5s apart. Ratio ~1:1.9, slightly short of 1:2. Pleasant straight: slightly creamier texture than 11.5, almost chocolate tones. Grind 12 set as Rockbrook dial-in; 12.5 test next.

Grind 12.5 confirmed (both evening-2 shots at 12.5, one each for Jamey and Kayla). Fastest Rockbrook pull yet: early flow spike ~2.5 g/s at first drip, avg 1.6 g/s. Yield on target (35.5g stop worked).

Grind 12.5 confirmed. 2.7s slower than #20, smoother early flow, avg 1.4 g/s. 12.5 averages ~24s vs ~30s at 12: half a step = ~6s, below the 27-32s window. Tasted worse than 12, lost the chocolate notes. Verdict: grind 12 is the Rockbrook setting; 12.5 retired.
